description: This file defines the MenuItemHighlightColors enumeration with a nested Palette struct, providing static methods to determine highlight colors based on a Boolean flag within a SwiftUI macOS application.

classes.name: MenuItemHighlightColors
classes.description: Enumeration providing color logic for menu item highlights based on selection state.

classes.name: Palette
classes.description: Struct encapsulating primary and secondary Colors for menu item highlighting.

methods.name: primary
methods.description: Returns the primary highlight Color based on whether the item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary
methods.description: Returns the secondary highlight Color with adjusted opacity based on highlight status.

methods.name: palette
methods.description: Creates a Palette instance with primary and secondary colors based on highlight status.
